summary: All eight registered claims reproduce independently from quarantine/orders.csv (values, CIs, test statistics, p, effects, n, population and period all match; no sign reversal by country; no comment-column leakage). One blocker: R05's caveat falsely states every shipping cell of the export was readable; 1778 cells in the kept population are blank or unparseable (870 literal nan/inf), so the claim of a complete shipping total is false. shipping_total is correctly not published, but the caveat is a false statement on an answer surface.
